summary: Tested company deletion (parziale/totale) + gzip backup on 3 TEST_T88 companies (isolation checks). Backend 11/12 pytest pass; the 1 failure: the backup (and GET /api/company) include the encrypted ftp_backup.password_enc and conservazione.password_enc, because COMPANY_PROJ does not exclude them. Parziale works: movements deleted, articles kept with stock set to 0, coge_chiusi removed, invoice numbering restarts at 1, masters/config/users unchanged, anagrafiche:true also removes parties/intenti/arch_anagrafiche, other companies untouched. Totale works: company and all its data deleted, company_ids pulled from users. Wrong conferma gives 400, non-admin gives 403, invalid modo gives 422. UI flow fully works: button disabled until the name matches (case-insensitive), switch only in parziale, backup downloaded, toasts shown, totale redirects and the app falls back to another company.

critical.issue: Backup JSON contains azienda.ftp_backup.password_enc and azienda.conservazione.password_enc (Fernet ciphertext). Spec says no encrypted secrets. Root cause: COMPANY_PROJ in server.py:199 only excludes smtp/sdi/banca secrets.

minor.issue: Same COMPANY_PROJ gap: it returns ftp_backup.password_enc and conservazione.password_enc to any user of the company, including non-admins.

action_items: Add 'ftp_backup.password_enc': 0 and 'conservazione.password_enc': 0 to COMPANY_PROJ (server.py:199). Check that FTP/conservazione code reading secrets uses a separate full find_one rather than t['company'].

Consider: totale also deletes cons_docs (conservazione decennale), whereas DELETE /companies/{cid} refuses this. Decide whether to block or warn (the UI text does mention 'documenti in conservazione').
critical_code_review_comments: Parziale keeps cons_docs and the SDI progressivo_invio counter. This is correct, because resetting progressivo would reuse SDI file names.
Totale uses list_collection_names minus ESCLUSE. Good, so future collections are covered automatically. Parziale uses a hardcoded MOVIMENTI list, so new movement collections must be added manually.
The deletion is not wrapped in a transaction or lock; a concurrent invoice creation during parziale could survive. Low risk.
seed_data_creation: TEST_T88 Alfa/Beta/Gamma companies + TEST_T88 admin/operatore users and sessions created via API/mongosh; all cleaned up (0 companies, 0 t88 users left).
